page.notes: The first and second marginal notes are beside the paragraphs they stand in; both were read with confidence. The "Objectio" paragraphs are italic in the scan, as are the lines of the objection texts; the responses are roman except for the quoted reasoning. Some abbreviations ("neq;", "atq;", "adeoq;", "rarumq;") are read from small, slightly blurred strokes and are not fully certain. The word "paucioribus" is clear in context but the scan is faint at that line end. The word "quale" at the foot is the catchword.
